item.title: Attackers Exploit AhsayCBS Flaws to Deploy Sandbox-Evading Python Backdoor
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an attack that exploited two now-patched vulnerabilities in AhsayCBS to deliver a Python-based implant. The activity, observed by Huntress in October 2026, involves the exploitation of a chain comprising CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands on affected systems. item.title: X.Org patches eight server vulnerabilities a month after fixing 12 others
item.description: X.Org has fixed eight vulnerabilities in the X.Org X server and Xwayland, including one in the Xorg server that lets a malicious monitor corrupt its memory. The fixes ship in xorg-server 21.1.26 and xwayland 24.1.15, and each of the eight affects versions before those two releases. The X server provides the low-level display layer for graphical desktops on many Linux and Unix systems.
